title: A Giant Pacific Octopus Can Have Up to 2,000 Suckers

scenes.text: A giant Pacific octopus has up to 2,000 suckers.
It has eight arms, each with two rows of suckers, as many as 250 per arm.
The record arm span is 25 feet.
A typical adult weighs about 50 pounds and spans 7 to 14 feet.
Its soft, extremely flexible body squeezes into tiny gaps.
Two thousand suckers on one animal.

description:
A giant Pacific octopus has eight arms with as many as 250 suckers each, up to 2,000 in total.
The record arm span is 25 feet.
What would you do with eight arms?
